detail: `ios_test.sh` 的「mute rc-0 abort」故障模式。**2026-08-05 成因更正**:原記「cleanup trap 吞 exit code」已被證偽——bash EXIT trap 不會把非零改成 0(最小反例 `cleanup(){ :; }; trap cleanup EXIT; set -euo pipefail; false` → rc=1;trap 內部再失敗亦然)。真正的 rc-0 缺口在 `ops/ios_test.sh:790` 的 `trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM` **共用 handler 且不 re-raise**:被 SIGTERM 打中後 script 從中斷點繼續往下跑、照常收尾 exit 0(已用最小案例複現)。另全檔**零 ERR trap**(`grep -c 'trap.*ERR'`=0;全 repo 僅 `kg_backup.sh:36`/`review_flip_probe.sh:196` 有)→ set -e 中止時零診斷輸出(原條目後半句成立)。cache-key 缺檔觸發點已修(`4d11a11d2`)。殘留風險:任何未 `|| true` 防護的管線都可能無聲假綠。候選:`:790` 拆成 `trap cleanup EXIT` + INT/TERM 專用 handler(cleanup 後解除 trap 再 self-kill 同號),並補 ERR trap 印 line/rc 到 stderr（兩度撞號:原 IMP-0013→改 0014 又撞 release 盤點→定 0017）
plan:
ROOT CAUSE re-verified 2026-08-05 by running the wiring, not by reading it. ops/ios_test.sh:790 is the ONLY trap in the file (grep -c "trap " -> 1) and installs one handler for three events: trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM. bash runs the handler and then RESUMES at the interrupted point; nothing re-raises. Measured repro (script with exactly that wiring, TERM-ed during sleep): "cleanup ran" printed TWICE, the line after sleep executed, process exited 0. In ios_test.sh the damage is not only the exit code: cleanup() at :646-663 fires MID-RUN while the run continues -- it kills CURRENT_XCODE_PID (:647), releases the per-device lock (:653), deletes the SHARED /tmp/kg-ios-build.lock (:654 release_build_lock), returns the leased pool simulator (:655-658), removes $TMPOUT (:660) and the staged .xctestrun (:662); the surviving code then keeps writing shared DerivedData with no lock held (parallel-agent corruption), and the EXIT trap runs cleanup a second time.

STEP 1 -- NEW FILE ops/lib/ios_signal_traps.sh (sourceable, bash 3.2 safe, no deps). Exact contents, modelled on the other extracted-for-testability libs (ops/lib/ios_run_verdict.sh, ops/lib/ios_test_discovery.sh):
  KG_SIGNAL_CLEANUP_FN=""
  KG_SIGNAL_CLEANUP_DONE=0
  kg_run_cleanup_once() { [[ "$KG_SIGNAL_CLEANUP_DONE" -eq 1 ]] && return 0; KG_SIGNAL_CLEANUP_DONE=1; [[ -n "$KG_SIGNAL_CLEANUP_FN" ]] && "$KG_SIGNAL_CLEANUP_FN"; return 0; }
  kg_on_signal() { local sig="$1"; echo "[ios_test] aborted by SIG$sig pid=$$" >&2; kg_run_cleanup_once; trap - EXIT "$sig"; kill -s "$sig" "$$"; exit $(( 128 + $(kill -l "$sig") )); }
  kg_install_signal_traps() { KG_SIGNAL_CLEANUP_FN="${1:?cleanup function required}"; KG_SIGNAL_CLEANUP_DONE=0; trap kg_run_cleanup_once EXIT; trap "kg_on_signal INT" INT; trap "kg_on_signal TERM" TERM; trap "kg_on_signal HUP" HUP; }
Header comment must state WHY: cleanup must run exactly once, and the process must die with the conventional 128+N status instead of resuming with locks already released. HUP is included on purpose -- today a dropped ssh session to felix leaks /tmp/kg-ios-build.lock because HUP has no handler at all.

STEP 2 -- ops/ios_test.sh, two edits only. (a) add the line: source "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/ios_signal_traps.sh" (with the matching shellcheck source= comment above it) into the source block at :233-244, after the ios_run_verdict.sh line at :241-242. (b) replace line 790 "trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM" with "kg_install_signal_traps cleanup". Do NOT touch cleanup() at :646-663 -- it is already idempotent (LOCK_HELD / TEST_DEVICE_LOCK_HELD guards, rm -f) and the once-guard makes double execution impossible anyway.

STEP 3 -- NEW TEST ops/tests/test_ios_signal_traps.sh, structured like ops/tests/test_ios_run_verdict.sh (LIB path, pass/fail counters, ok/fail_t/section helpers, mktemp -d + trap cleanup EXIT, final [[ $fail -eq 0 ]]). Start with the same preflight: [[ -f "$LIB" ]] || { echo "FATAL: $LIB missing"; exit 1; } -- that is what makes this file red before STEP 1 exists. Fixture: write a victim script into the temp dir that sources the lib, defines cleanup() appending one line to a marker file, calls kg_install_signal_traps cleanup, sleeps 5, then echoes RESUMED and exits 0. Assertions: (1) bash -n on the lib; (2) TERM -> victim rc is 143, marker file has exactly 1 line, victim stdout has no RESUMED; (3) HUP -> rc 129, marker exactly 1 line; (4) an uninterrupted variant (sleep 0) -> rc 0 and marker exactly 1 line, so the fix cannot be faked by always dying. Do NOT try to test INT: measured 2026-08-05, bash sets SIGINT to SIG_IGN for a background child of a non-interactive shell and a signal ignored on entry cannot be trapped, so the harness cannot deliver it (still no-op under bash -mc). Say that in a comment instead of writing a test that passes for the wrong reason.

STEP 4 -- register the new group in BOTH planes or the suite goes red. (a) ops/test_ops.sh: add ios-signal-traps to DEFAULT_TESTS next to ios-run-verdict (:52) and add the case arm "ios-signal-traps)  ./ops/tests/test_ios_signal_traps.sh ;;" next to :139. (b) ops/tests/test_ops_ci_coverage.sh: add ios-signal-traps to LINUX_GROUPS (pure bash, no Xcode, no assets) -- every DEFAULT_TESTS group must be classified exactly once or the ops-ci-coverage group fails with "unclassified". No OPS_SHELL_TEST_ALIASES edit is needed: worktree_orchestrate.py:_ops_shell_test_candidates already maps ops/lib/ios_signal_traps.sh to ops/tests/test_ios_signal_traps.sh by name.

STEP 5 -- DO NOT implement the ERR trap this entry proposes. Measured both variants today: with set -E the trap fires on commands that are handled and do not abort (3 spurious hits in a 12-line probe: inside "x=$(false) || true", inside a function called from "if ! out=$(g)") -- that is stderr noise on every healthy run; without set -E it never fires for the case that matters, because the ERR trap is not inherited by functions and ios_test.sh aborts from inside functions (probe: top-level call to a failing function printed nothing and still exited 1). A silent-record-then-report-at-EXIT variant was considered and rejected: an explicit "exit 1" would then be reported with a stale unrelated ERR line, i.e. a diagnostic naming the wrong cause.

OUT OF SCOPE, on purpose: writing an aborted verdict file on the signal path. A signalled run has no verdict by definition, and staleness is already detectable -- kg_ios_verdict_identity_kv stamps ts=/pid=/cwd= into every verdict (regression guard 4 in ops/tests/test_ios_run_verdict.sh).

MUST STAY GREEN: ./ops/test_ios_test_discovery.sh (the routed test for ops/ios_test.sh, worktree_orchestrate.py:242), ./ops/tests/test_ops_ci_coverage.sh, bash -n ops/ios_test.sh.
